## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Healthcare, Energy and Financials are positive while Technology and Communication are weak, and leadership is Narrow (3/5 Healthcare) — supports a neutral, selective posture.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND. Energy constructive: XOM (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing support: CVS (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +11.13%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -7.79%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Communication under pressure: GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +11.13%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -15.95% | 1M: +22.01%) CORRECTION, PLTR (1W: -15.05% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -14.64% | 1M: +8.85%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -13.78% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND is receiving bullish headlines — watch for distribution; MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND is another big-name momentum breakdown.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure with concentrated selling; AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND is an exception while MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: negative (1W: -6.51%, 24 stocks) — rotation within tech and notable trend exhaustion cases (IBM, ORCL, NOW, PANW).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed-to-constructive: JPM (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +3.58%) ABOVE TREND, but V (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: modestly positive (1W: +0.76%, 20 stocks) — favors selective bank/capacity names rather than broad beta.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare leading and broad: LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +4.94%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: positive (1W: +2.86%, 17 stocks) — durable leadership for now.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Healthcare and select Energy/Financial names given broad Healthcare strength and positive sector breadth, and reduce exposure to high-multiple Technology names showing trend breaks; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-stock concentration. Monitor SHOP, MSFT and ORCL for follow-through or further distribution — major divergence argues for selective positioning and waiting for confirmations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -15.95% | 1M: +22.01%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +3.86%) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.51% | 1M: +6.28%) and Communication (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -7.04%) — watch for further rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim recent weekly resistance would confirm extension of weakness; AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION — close below 1M bias would signal deeper pullback; LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent weekly lows to confirm continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+65): GLP-1 oral pill wins vs peers; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) — sentiment confirmed. DE (+55): tariff relief/positive margins; price RECOVERY (1W: +5.76% | 1M: -1.19%) — watch follow-through. MSFT (+55): NHS Copilot deal; price BELOW TREND (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) — sentiment diverging from price, monitor for buying exhaustion.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-50): TurboTax probes; price BELOW TREND (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -24.90%) — sentiment confirming weakness. PANW (-50): weak quarter headline; price CORRECTION (1W: -11.37% | 1M: +35.52%) — near-term pullback inside longer-term gain, watch for trend break. AAPL (-40): AI pivot concerns; price CORRECTION (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) — sentiment adds risk to short-term recovery.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is Technology dispersion and major divergences (MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND despite bullish headlines) — watch for trend confirmation.
